notes.title: New Cat Type and Clothes - Developer Update #2 - Whiskara
notes.notes:
Hiya everyone!

A few days ago I started doing developer updates to let you all know how development is going, and I have done so much. I have created a new type of cat that'll appear in game, a humble tabby cat. This cat type will exist within the valley alongside the other characters.

image showing the new tabby cat type without clothing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/ca5d84f1ed3e21b633609323120d34d6e7fe2dd8.png[/img]

Clothing, you may have already noticed that both Charlie and Dad both wear a knitted cardigan, however they don't wear any lower concealment, and other characters don't wear any clothing whatsoever. So in Alpha 1.2 all characters will be wearing clothing, however, upon release you won't be able to customise Lyra's appearance, maybe in a later update I will add a feature like that.

images depicting cat in clothing, colours are for contrast, upon release they'll have proper textures. And more clothing types will be included.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/69724b043927d1b28b8c9a4716f76cdbcdb64541.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/a402b888dd801cb1e83d923ce5045b6a5f11073f.png[/img]

This is all I have to share this week, the story is starting to take much better form, but more tweaking is required. I'll keep you all updated, see you soon! and thanks for the support!

notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
I am really embarrassed to make this announcement again, but Alpha 1.2 will not be releasing this March, I am no longer going to make any promises on a release date for this update, I still have a lot to do, and I've not had the time to work on the project for personal reasons I don't want to get into.

However I can say it will 100% be out this year, I will start taking this much more seriously, and I will start doing these developer updates to let you all know how the project is getting along. Unfortunately I am a perfectionist when it comes to Whiskara, for better and for worse. I am hyper-focused on making the game as good as I'm capable of doing, but it comes at the cost of having infinite delays. So I have to put my foot down and just do with what I've got, and if I'm not personally happy with it, I'll worry about it later.

Once again, I am sorry for not keeping my promised release schedule. But things will get better, keep an eye out for more of these developer updates in the near future.

notes.title: New Changes for the Upcoming Whiskara Alpha 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last month I announced the changes for Whiskara A1.2, and since making that announcement, I've decided to add extra features. These features were originally going to be added in A1.3, however I thought it would've been better to add it to A1.2 instead.

[b]New Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Caves Area - Finally, after many months, the caves will be added to the game.
[*] Saving System - Alpha 1.2 will include a saving and loading system, so if you need to step away from the game, you will be able to continue where you left off.
[*] Skills - A new agility skill will be added, this skill will improve the your stamina and running speed, there are a total of 10 agility skill levels to be learned.
[*] Environment - Alpha 1.2 will have new tree and bush models with better optimisation, there will also be new forest area to explore, in the valley.
[*] Graphics - The game will use a standard shader instead of a stylised shader, this is because of limitations and issues with the custom stylised shader. The game will still retain a stylised look, but without toon shading. The terrain textures have also been updated.
[*] UI - The UI in alpha 1.2 will be overhauled with new textures.
[/list]

[b]Delay[/b]

The update will have to be delayed to add this new content, perhaps to sometime in March, hopefully no later than that, but delays may happen for any reason.

notes.title: Whiskara Alpha 1.2 - What Will Happen In This Big Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last week I made an announcement, I said that Whiskara was going to change a lot. I completely forgot to follow it up with another announcement to tell you all what will actually be changing, so here is that late announcement post.

[b] Big Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game engine will be updated to Unity 6, as it is more stable and faster, so development will be easier.
[*] As you may already know, some of the story will be rewritten, same goes for some character backstory.
[*] The quest system in the game will be completely overhauled, the old one was fine, but it has it's limits and is very janky. This new one is much better and has many new features. The way you get these quests is by asking an NPC if they have any quests, and if they do, you can select from the list of quests and accept one. Right now only one quest can be active at a time.
[*] NPC dialogue is now mostly there for plot purposes. However, some NPCs will have dialogue that can affect the course of the game, but it isn't going to be as big of a feature as it currently is in Alpha 1.1, so when the 1.2 update comes out, the "Choice-Driven Storytelling" feature mentioned on the Steam page will most likely be removed or changed to reflect it's lesser importance to the gameplay.
[*] The font used in the game will no longer be Boombox, it will instead be replaced with Better VCR font. Even though I haven't seen any user issues with the Boombox font used in-game, an uppercase font is not very legible.
[*] due to how the game will work in 1.2, some achievements are no longer possible to attain (Specifically: 'The Butterfly Effect', 'Stupid Is As Stupid Does', and 'Love Is In The Air'), so they will be removed from the game.
[/list]

[b] Small Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The UI has had some polishing to look a bit better on the eyes
[*] Shadow quality will be much better
[/list]

[b]Even after the change in direction, the game sound will still be improved:[/b]
[list]
[*] Subtle ambient music will be added
[*] Footstep sounds will be added
[*] Sound for when Lyra is out of breath will be added
[*] NPC voices are going to be remade, so some NPCs will have their own unique voices
[/list]

here are some screenshots from Alpha 1.2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/d4ba39849a9c5ca14a0919d2c172d79a081c6c1d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/753c89a7cd1dfe0e742a1f98ef8c81a21ed6dab0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45242420/e4c73548bc58af9f63a40d168949c48cc21e8939.png[/img]

[b]Thank You![/b]
Alpha 1.2 is going to be a huge update, and I expect it to be ready sometime in [b]mid-late February[/b], but delays may happen if I don't feel like the update is ready. In some way I regret releasing the game in such an unfinished state, I do apologise. But let's just look at the future of the game, it will only get better from here, and with the feedback from you all, we can truly make this game amazing!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Whiskara Alpha 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This is a big moment for me, the first update for my first game on Steam. I’ll be honest, it’s been a tough start. Not much in revenue so far and no community feedback yet, it’s clear I’m still at the very beginning of this journey. But every big project starts somewhere, and I’m proud of what I’ve built so far.

I’ve made some small improvements in this update to polish the experience:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Fixed an oversight in dad's first dialogue: after dad says "I want to make sure my little princess is healthy", it now has three full-stops instead of commas 
- Fixed an oversight in Charlie’s first dialogue: the caves are now properly referred to as "caves," not "mines."
- Character dialogue will no longer start after dialogue is finished
- Enemies now play a sound effect upon death
- The gate at the cave is no longer open
- Added new tips in the loading screen
- Improved loading times

I’m excited to continue refining the game and building a community around it. If you’ve played the game, thank you, it means everything. If you’re new, I’d love for you to jump in and share your thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps make this project better.
